name: Superior Hunter's Mark
description: Hunter's Mark damage becomes 1d10. Once per rest, the mark persists for its remaining duration while you concentrate on something else.

name: Second Favored Enemy and Mark Mastery
description: Choose a second Favored Enemy. While Hunter's Mark is active, once per turn you can move it to a new target with no action.

name: Swift Quarry
description: Hunter's Mark damage becomes 2d6, and once per turn you can place or move it as part of the Attack action.

name: Hunter's Mark
description: Bonus action, 90 ft, a creature you can see, concentration up to 1 hour: once per turn when you hit it, deal +1d6 damage (1d10 at 11, 2d6 at 23); you have advantage on checks to track it. Cast it free PB times per long rest, or with a slot. If the target drops to 0 HP, move the mark as a bonus action.

name: Apex Ranger Capstone
description: Bonus action, 1 minute, 1 use per long rest: your Favored Terrain benefits apply everywhere, Hunter's Mark can be on up to 3 targets, and your first hit each turn against a marked creature is a critical hit.

name: Twin Souls
description: Once on each of your turns, your companion makes one attack for free without your command, and you and your companion share Hunter's Mark concentration (damage to either can't break it).

name: Shared Mark
description: Your companion's hits deal your Hunter's Mark damage (once per turn) against your marked target.

name: Flurry Mark
description: When both of your weapons hit the same creature in one turn, apply or refresh Hunter's Mark on it without an action or a free cast.

name: Veil Step
description: Bonus action, PB uses per long rest: you become invisible until the start of your next turn or until you attack, and your next attack roll before then has advantage. Oath spells: False Face, Prey Brand (3rd tier at 9: Terror Wave, Scryshroud).
